limitations: No physical lens IO, driver execution, lens motion completion, timing or mechanical eligibility is established. The payload unit/direction meaning is unchanged from prior bounded producer evidence.

18 cases are new scoped checks, not added prior checks: constructor slot-loop fragment1, complete builder/copy/enqueue6, null-extra preservation1, slots-full1, complete queue-pop3, task-entry through one drain5, completion mismatch1.

OS queue-push is a capture stub and OS receive supplies a synthetic node; original generic push is retained statically. Actual queue scheduling, concurrency and failed-pop behavior inside the loop are not established. Pop failure outputs preservation is observed under a stub that does not write destination on failure.

Task startup/registration are static source and vtable evidence; runtime tests start at the registered generic entry530f3c10 with synthetic context. Infinite task loop is bounded at second wait, not claimed to return normally.

Packet helper52f18128, cache child5315dc68, post-exchange child5315e480, completion payload child52efde0c and cleanup child52eff2c8 are stubs in these tests. A forced exchange return7 checks conditional control only, not an observed physical transport failure.
C+52f3, context+9b and arbitration-state producers are outside this pass. A gate-consumed test input is not proof that any particular lens or UI produces it.

D+c is initialized to zero by constructor slot loop; S+c==0 does not clear it on allocation. This pass does not establish the invariant of every slot reuse/reset path or prove a real stale-pointer event.

Asynchronous options.byte0=0 was used for builder/copy cases. Nonzero options allocation/wait behavior, other opcodes, special commands1/2/3 and generalized malformed descriptor behavior were not numerically covered.
Genuine angr C is retained unedited, with inferred types/control artifacts; conclusions use original ARM and scoped execution. Full saved ranges do not imply every branch was tested.
All offsets are hexadecimal. Descriptor command0x8900 and request opcode0x1b are separate fields. Token construction uses additions modulo2^32, not a presumed bitwise OR for unconstrained options.
